description: Kreis Viersen: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kreis Viersen. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
